runs_real_software_note: REAL Budibase official all-in-one images per version (budibase/budibase:3.31.5 / 3.32.0 / 3.35.4), each bundling the genuine app + worker (Koa) + CouchDB + MinIO + Redis + nginx. A real admin is onboarded and logged in; the real Worker CSRF middleware (backend-core/middleware/csrf.ts using matchers.ts) makes the skip/enforce decision. No source lift; the vulnerable code is the shipped image's own middleware.

audit.evidence: Version model VERIFIED from real Budibase git-tag source, correcting the build brief's assumed V1=3.31.5: server/middleware/utils.ts (CVE-2026-31816) is byte-identical 3.31.4->3.31.5 and first anchored at 3.32.0; backend-core/middleware/matchers.ts (CVE-2026-48147) is byte-identical 3.31.5->3.32.0 (untouched by the CVE-2026-31816 fix) and first anchored at 3.35.4. Live gate on real Docker (see repro.log): ORIGINAL server auth-bypass GET /api/tables?/webhooks/trigger reaches@V0 (401->500 guard skipped), blocked@V1 & V2 (401); RESIDUAL worker CSRF-skip state-write POST /api/global/configs?a=/api/global/auth/x (form-urlencoded, admin cookie, NO x-csrf-token, config[company]=FLAG) reaches@V0 & V1 (200, GET /api/global/configs/public -> company==FLAG), blocked@V2 (403 Invalid CSRF token, company unchanged). control (no injection)=403 on all versions; original webhook pattern does NOT bypass worker CSRF (403 on V1) so original!=residual. passed=true.

product: Budibase (Budibase/budibase) — open-source low-code application platform (Node.js / Koa)
app_purpose: Self-hosted low-code platform whose Worker service exposes the global admin/tenant API (user invites, SSO/SMTP/branding config, user management); those state-changing POST/PUT/DELETE endpoints are protected by a synchronizer-token CSRF middleware.
root_cause: CSRF (CWE-352) via Incorrect Regular Expression (CWE-185): unanchored regex tested against the full request URL (incl. query string) lets an injected public-route pattern turn off CSRF token validation
mechanism_family: unanchored-regex-on-full-request-url query-string injection; the first fix anchored server/middleware/utils.ts but left the sibling backend-core/middleware/matchers.ts (used by the Worker CSRF middleware) untouched
sink: packages/backend-core/src/middleware/csrf.ts :: csrf() -> matches(ctx, noCsrfOptions) from packages/backend-core/src/middleware/matchers.ts; when a NO_CSRF public-route regex matches ctx.request.url (unanchored, full URL) the middleware returns next() and skips token validation

v0.ref: budibase/budibase:3.31.5 (pre CVE-2026-31816 fix; server utils.ts AND backend-core matchers.ts both unanchored -> server auth-bypass AND worker CSRF-bypass both open)

v1.ref: budibase/budibase:3.32.0 (CVE-2026-31816 fix in server/middleware/utils.ts = TARGET; backend-core/middleware/matchers.ts byte-identical to V0 -> worker CSRF-bypass STILL open)

v2.ref: budibase/budibase:3.35.4 (CVE-2026-48147 fix anchors backend-core/middleware/matchers.ts -> worker CSRF-bypass closed)

flag.resource: the Worker global `settings` config document's `company` field, a CSRF-protected admin-only state-write on POST /api/global/configs, publicly read back via GET /api/global/configs/public
flag.placement: authz-seeded-state-write: the per-run ${PCB_FLAG} is submitted as config[company] in a cross-origin-shaped POST (admin session cookie present, but NO valid x-csrf-token, simple content-type application/x-www-form-urlencoded). The value is written into server-side state ONLY IF the CSRF middleware skips validation. A baseline (csrf-valid) write resets company to 'ResetBase' before each probe; nothing is planted in image code.
flag.detect: read back GET /api/global/configs/public; config.company == ${PCB_FLAG} iff the CSRF token check was skipped (state-write landed). For the original (server auth-bypass) canary, 'reached' = the normally-401 endpoint returns a non-401 (handler reached) status when the webhook pattern is injected.
flag.benign_note: Only a global branding string (company name) is set to a random token and read back from the public settings endpoint; no invite is sent, no user/credential/tenant is mutated, and no live cross-origin navigation is performed.

given_to_method: v1 env handle (budibase/budibase:3.32.0, compose profile v1, http://127.0.0.1:10081)

evidence.fix_reference: budibase/budibase:3.32.0 (CVE-2026-31816 fix in server/middleware/utils.ts = TARGET; backend-core/middleware/matchers.ts byte-identical to V0 -> worker CSRF-bypass STILL open); budibase/budibase:3.35.4 (CVE-2026-48147 fix anchors backend-core/middleware/matchers.ts -> worker CSRF-bypass closed)
evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: CVE-2026-48147 is 'a direct sibling of CVE-2026-31816': CVE-2026-31816 fixed the unanchored-regex-on-full-URL bug in server/middleware/utils.ts but left backend-core/middleware/matchers.ts untouched, and the Worker CSRF middleware (csrf.ts) uses matchers.ts to decide whether to skip token validation. Verified from source: matchers.ts is byte-identical between 3.31.5 (V0) and 3.32.0 (V1 = CVE-2026-31816 patch) and is anchored only at 3.35.4 (V2).
